description.narrative: Country portfolio budget - CPB Nepal 2019-2023 Provide a gender-transformative and nutrition-sensitive school meals and health package in chronically food-insecure areas and strengthen the Government’s capacity to integrate the national school meals programme into the National Social Protection Framework.

sector.narrative: By 2030, end all forms of malnutrition, including achieving, by 2025, the internationally agreed targets on stunting and wasting in children under 5 years of age, and address the nutritional needs of adolescent girls, pregnant and lactating women and older persons
